name: 3D Ring Visibility & Occlusion Test
definition: Algorithm to project 3D ring segments to screen space, compute depth via inverse-linear interpolation, and validate visibility against a voxel depth buffer.
summary: The 3D Ring Visibility & Occlusion Test is a screen-space rasterization technique that determines voxel visibility by projecting ring segments to screen space, differing from analytical world-space methods.
